description: Unplanned corruption or schema mismatch resulting in critical historical data loss during ETL/cutover
defaultMitigation: Implement parallel data validation pipelines, automated SHA-256 checksum verification, and dual-run reconciliations before final cutover.

description: Breakdowns in legacy on-premise connectors or asynchronous middleware queues causing operational outages
defaultMitigation: Deploy API gateway mediation layer (SAP Integration Suite / MuleSoft) and conduct end-to-end integration stress tests in sandbox environment.

description: Internal user friction and low initial adoption caused by unfamiliar interfaces and changed operational procedures
defaultMitigation: Form department change champions, rollout phased role-based interactive training, and track weekly user engagement KPIs.

description: Accidental misconfiguration of SaaS tenant access permissions, public bucket exposures, or regulatory non-compliance
defaultMitigation: Enforce automated Zero Trust policies, federated Single Sign-On (SSO/MFA), and perform third-party SOC2 compliance audits prior to go-live.

riskTitle: Vendor Lock-in and Unforeseen Cost Escalation
description: Proprietary data models and unexpected licensing cost increases making future migration or expansion costly
defaultMitigation: Negotiate multi-year price locks, maintain open API data extraction pipelines, and demand standard formats (JSON/Parquet) for database exports.
